figures.finding: No incentive found (the Kenya Film Commission's funding page carries no content in its served HTML). What a series must pay is the KFCB filming licence under Cap 222: per episode or per season, plus per filming day.

figures.finding: Not found. No Kenyan public fund for a theatre production with published terms was found. The Kenya Cultural Centre (a state corporation) runs the County Theatre Fiesta and the national theatre, but its page read sets no grant; a web search reported the Sports, Arts and Social Development Fund behind the Fiesta (a lead: not read). Hii Stage closed with its 2024 round; no newer call was found.
